subject: Pharmaco — EU-only processing & SCCs: jurisdictional scope and operational evidence
messages:
From: Emily Stone <emily.stone@pharmaco.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ivan Petrov <ivan.petrov@pharmaco.com>
Date: 2026-09-14T12:10:00+02:00
Subject: EU-only processing — SCCs & evidence request

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. Pharmaco's legal and security teams need a clear written confirmation of two things before we proceed to procurement: 

1) Can Redwood guarantee that all Pharmaco production data (requests, responses, embeddings, KV caches, and backups) will be processed and stored only within EU jurisdictions (specific data centers in DE/FR/IE) when we select the "EU-only" deployment?

2) With respect to Schrems II and the SCCs, please outline the operational controls and evidence you can provide for:
   - Execution of SCCs (we expect standard EU SCCs executed with signatures)
   - Supplementary measures (encryption, key ownership, access controls)
   - Proofs of deletion for historical backups/restore points (how will you demonstrate deletion to auditors)

I've attached a spreadsheet with the initial set of questions from legal (Pharmaco_SCCs_Requests.xlsx). Can we get a written response and a short follow-up call next week with your SOC/compliance lead?

Appreciate it — Emily

--
Emily Stone
Head of Legal Operations
Pharmaco Inc
Attachment: Pharmaco_SCCs_Requests.xlsx

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@pharmaco.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-14T15:32:00+02:00
Subject: Re: EU-only processing — SCCs & evidence request

Emily —

Thanks for the clear list. Short answer up front: yes, Redwood can run Pharmaco on an EU-only deployment with SCCs executed, and we can provide operational evidence and deletion attestations — with some caveats around retained logs for platform health that we'll outline below. 

High-level commitments we can make immediately:
- EU-only processing: when you select "Private (EU)" or our Dedicated EU pools we pin compute and storage to EU regions (we currently operate certified zones in DE, FR, and IE). This includes primary storage and persistent volumes.
- Backups & restore points: backups can be configured to remain in-region. We offer backup lifecycle policies and can run retention/deletion jobs on a customer cadence.
- SCCs: Redwood will execute the EU Commission standard contractual clauses. We will sign SCCs with Pharmaco (we have a template) and provide a list of subprocessors for your review.

Operational nuance:
- Control plane metadata: some control-plane telemetry and billing metadata (non-customer payload) may transit our control plane for orchestrations; for Private install we offer an option where the control plane sits in the customer's VPC.
- Logs & troubleshooting traces: we retain platform diagnostic logs for a configurable short window (default 30 days). If Pharmaco requires shorter retention or immediate purge after incident scoping we can build a narrower policy.

Attaching a short summary we typically share with security teams (redwood-eu-hosting-summary.pdf).

Next steps: I'd like to introduce Naomi (applied ML infra/compliance) and Lauren (enterprise solutions) on a call to walk your security/IT team through the controls. When would you and Ivan be available?

Best,
Rafael
Head of Sales, EMEA
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-eu-hosting-summary.pdf

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@pharmaco.com>, Ivan Petrov <ivan.petrov@pharmaco.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-15T09:22:00+02:00
Subject: Re: EU-only processing — SCCs & evidence request

Hi Emily / Ivan —

Quick technical breakdown to supplement Rafael's note:

1) Data residency and storage
   - Primary and persistent storage: we pin to customer-chosen EU regions (DE/FR/IE). Physical replicas and object storage are provisioned in-region only.
   - Caches (KV cache): KV cache is ephemeral and tied to the serving cluster; we guarantee eviction on instance termination and can configure TTLs and explicit flush APIs.

2) Encryption & key ownership
   - At-rest encryption: AES-256. For Private deployments we support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own KMS/HSM) so Redwood never has plaintext access.
   - In-transit: TLS 1.3 for client-to-edge and internal service-to-service comms.

3) Backups, retention, and deletion evidence
   - Backups: configurable retention windows; can be set to in-region-only.
   - Deletion proof: we provide deletion runs (log of deletion job, snapshots removed, checksums) and a time-stamped manifest. For high-assurance customers we can run certified deletion workflows and provide an auditor-friendly report.

4) SCCs + supplementary measures
   - We will execute SCCs with Pharmaco. In addition, we propose these supplementary measures: customer-managed KMS (no Redwood access), strict EU-only subprocessors, IP allowlists, network isolation via VPC peering, and encryption of any exported logs.

5) Subprocessors and access controls
   - We'll supply the current subprocessor list and our onboarding checklists; subprocessors for storage and monitoring can be set to EU-only for this contract.

Action items I recommend:
- Provide your legal with our SCC template and subprocessor list (we'll send both).
- Decide whether you want customer-managed KMS (recommended for Pharmaco).
- Agree retention windows for logs/backups so we can produce deletion playbook.

Link to our shared evidence folder: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/pharmaco-eu-evidence

On the call we can walk through sample deletion manifests and the deletion-schedule SLA.

Regards,
Naomi Feldman
Principal, Applied ML Infrastructure & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Emily Stone <emily.stone@pharmaco.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ivan Petrov <ivan.petrov@pharmaco.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-16T11:05:00+02:00
Subject: Re: EU-only processing — SCCs & evidence request

Thanks Naomi — that's helpful. A few follow-ups from legal/security: 

- Backups/restore points: We need a clear description of how you guarantee deletion from historical backups if we request data deletion (both manual on-demand and according to retention policy). Specifically: how will you remove older EBS/object snapshots and any off-host replicas, and what evidence will you give us?

- KV cache and ephemeral caches: we need an API-level promise that a cache flush will remove residual vectors and provide a confirmation identifier we can store.

- Control plane telemetry: our risk team insists on minimal external egress of metadata. If the control plane is managed by Redwood (hosted), what metadata leaves the EU? For private deployment we need documentation on the control plane VPC option.

Legal would like an executed attestation (DocuSign) for the deletion process and a short SLA stating timelines for deletion of backups (e.g., within 30 days for on-demand deletion requests).

Can your team draft the deletion attestation and a template proof-of-deletion report we could present to auditors?

Best,
Emily

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-09-17T16:45:00+02:00
Subject: RE: Pharmaco — EU-only processing & SCCs: jurisdictional scope and operational evidence

Emily and team —

Thanks for the detailed questions — I'll summarize commitments so legal/security have a single doc to review. This is our proposed scope for the Pharmaco engagement: 

1) EU-only processing & storage
   - Commitment: production data, KV caches, backups, and persistent storage will be provisioned in the chosen EU regions (DE/FR/IE) for the contract term.

2) SCCs and supplementary measures
   - Redwood will execute the EU Commission SCCs with Pharmaco. Supplementary measures: customer-managed KMS (BYOK), EU-only subprocessors, VPC network isolation, and encrypted diagnostic exports.

3) Deletion assurances & evidence
   - On-demand deletion: Redwood will run a deletion workflow that removes data from primary storage, triggers backup lifecycle deletion, and flushes KV caches.
   - Proof-of-deletion: we will provide a time-stamped manifest containing deletion job id, list of removed object ids/snapshots, and checksums where applicable. We also provide a template auditor report.
   - SLA proposal: for on-demand deletion requests, Redwood will complete primary-data deletion within 7 calendar days and backup deletion workflow within 30 calendar days unless otherwise contractually agreed.

4) Control plane options
   - Hosted: control-plane telemetry includes orchestration metadata (job ids, instance ids) but not customer payload.
   - Private: we can deploy a customer-controlled control plane inside your VPC to eliminate outbound control-plane telemetry.

Deliverables (what we'll send next):
- Executable SCCs template & signature-ready DocuSign link (https://docusign.com/PHAR/attest/12345)
- Subprocessor list (EU-only filtered)
- Deletion attestation draft and proof_of_deletion_template.pdf (attached)
- SCCs_execution_plan.docx (attached)

Action items:
- Emily: confirm you want BYOK KMS and the proposed deletion SLA (7/30 days).
- Rafael/Naomi: prepare the SCCs execution packet and the deletion attestation for DocuSign.
- Lauren/Aditya: schedule a 30-minute follow-up call to walk Pharmaco's IT on the deletion manifest and KMS setup (proposed 2026-09-21).

We appreciate the attention to detail here. We'll circulate the formal packet by EOD Monday.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
VP, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
Attachments: SCCs_execution_plan.docx, proof_of_deletion_template.pdf
